assertions.name: covariance_epic_phase6_marginal_stein_step1
assertions.source: Marginal Stein ingredients A(n),B(n) for the ω₃ (3-cycle) content-spread computed on the Plancherel down-up chain; eigenfunction identity E[(ΔW)²]=2τ₃ (τ₃=3/n) verified n≤12. First step of the effective-Stein program; the joint (ln f,ω₃) BE bound remains open. No fit; no c_k.

description: Phase 6 (effective-Stein program) STEP 1 of the covariance-kernel epic (qou-x631): the marginal Stein/Berry–Esseen ingredients for the 3-cycle content-spread ω₃ (Fulman math/0305423 did only k=2/transposition; this is k=3). On the Plancherel-reversible down-up chain, W=ω₃/σ (σ²=Var_P(ω₃)) has E[W*|W]=(1−3/n)W; the exchangeable-pair BE bound is governed by A(n)=(1/τ₃)√Var_P(E[(ΔW)²|λ]) and B(n)=√(E_P|ΔW|³/τ₃), τ₃=3/n. Computed both across n and estimated their log-log decay rate (the k=3 analogue of Fulman's n^-1/4 transposition rate). Consistency verified: E_P[(ΔW)²]=2τ₃, E_P[W]=0, Var_P(W)=1 all n≤12. SCOPE: this is the MARGINAL CLT ingredient (stepping stone); it does NOT bound the kernel (the JOINT covariance Cov(f,ω₃)) — the joint effective Berry–Esseen on (ln f,ω₃) is the open core (STEP 2+, multi-session, not in the literature). scope-(a); no fit; nothing wired; no c_k; L2 2/7.

data.scope_note: marginal only; kernel needs joint (ln f, omega3) effective BE (open)
